front.title: Scenarios and Routing Requirements for Mega-Constellation LEO Satellite Networks

author.organization: China Satellite Network Group Co., Ltd.
China Satellite Network Group Co., Ltd.

abstract.t:
Large-scale Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellations equipped with optical Inter-Satellite Links (ISLs) are evolving toward multi- hop spaceborne transport networks. Multi-vendor constellation deployments, interconnection with terrestrial networks, and potential interconnection among heterogeneous satellite systems introduce requirements for interoperable routing behavior and reachability exchange. At the same time, large constellation size, time-varying topology, unplanned link disruptions, and constrained on-board resources raise scalability and stability challenges for routing mechanisms.
This document describes representative deployment and interoperability scenarios, examines the limitations of network-wide fine-grained link-state distribution and existing mitigation approaches, and identifies routing requirements for scalable state management, topology-change handling, fast recovery, and inter- network reachability.
